newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Samsung sees 3.5 trln won info/telecom '97 sales.
newsitem.headline: Samsung sees 3.5 trln won info/telecom '97 sales.

text.p: Samsung Electronics Co Ltd said on Thursday it had set a sales target of 3.5 trillion won for its information and telecommunications division in 1997, up from an estimated 2.7 trillion for this year.
A spokesman of Samsung Electronics, flagship company of South Korea's Samsung Group, said about 30 percent of the sales would be from exports.
"The R&D ratio to sales for Samsung's information and telecommunications business exceeds 10 percent while the company's overall R&D ratio reachs only six percent," Byon said.
Samsung Electronics aims to become the world's third largest mobile telecommunications equipment producer in the year 2000 against 14th now, he added.
